clue.text: Provide means of protection to an international couturier

parts.note: to arm someone is to give them weapons to defend themselves

explanation.surface: A fashion house is offered something to keep it safe.
explanation.definitionFit: Giorgio Armani is a world-famous Italian fashion designer, so the surname names a global couturier.

clue.text: Having eggs always produces small animal

parts.note: a fish that is roed carries roe, its mass of eggs
e'er is the poetic contraction of ever, meaning always

explanation.surface: A creature that is forever carrying eggs turns out to be a small beast.
explanation.walkthrough: EER is the poetic E'ER written without its apostrophe.
explanation.definitionFit: The roe deer is a small European species of deer, so it is fairly described as a small animal.

clue.text: High point to visit regularly in fair weather

indicators.note: taking letters at regular intervals from the words that follow, here the second, fourth and so on

explanation.surface: A mountain summit is best visited when the weather is good.
explanation.definitionFit: An arête is a sharp mountain ridge, a lofty spot on a climb.

clue.text: Step in to bury archdeacon with earl

parts.note: to inter is to bury a body
Ven, short for Venerable, is the title used for an archdeacon in the Church of England

explanation.surface: Someone steps in to see a churchman and a nobleman buried together.
explanation.definitionFit: To intervene is to come between parties or get involved, which is stepping in.

clue.text: Analogue standard everybody starts to employ less

parts.note: par is the standard or normal level
all means everybody

indicators.note: the opening letters of the two words that follow are taken

explanation.surface: A comparable standard is one that everybody begins to use less often.
explanation.definitionFit: An analogue is something comparable or corresponding, and a parallel is a counterpart of the same kind.

clue.text: Task to guard judge for short time

indicators.note: judge stands for, replacing, the time abbreviation in the guard word

parts.note: to protect is to guard
T is the short form of time

explanation.surface: A briefly assigned task is to keep watch over a judge.
explanation.walkthrough: PROTECT has two Ts; it is the first one that becomes J.
explanation.definitionFit: A project is a planned piece of work, a task undertaken.

clue.text: Perch has bone in decay

indicators.note: the bone word sits inside the decay word

parts.note: rot is decay
os is the Latin and anatomical word for bone

explanation.surface: A bird's perch has a bone in rotting wood.
explanation.definitionFit: A roost is a place where birds settle to rest, a perch.

clue.text: Without haste place flower arrangements on River Kolyma's centre

parts.note: leis are Hawaiian garlands of flowers placed round the neck
the Ure is a river in Yorkshire

indicators.note: the middle two letters of the Russian river's name are taken

explanation.surface: Someone calmly lays wreaths at the middle of the Kolyma, a Siberian river.
explanation.definitionFit: Leisurely means unhurried, doing things in a relaxed way.

clue.text: No sign of mistake in outside exam — it's unchangeable

indicators.note: no means the mistake mark is absent from the exam word

parts.note: an external is an exam set or marked by an outside body
a cross, X, marks a wrong answer

explanation.surface: An outside examination with no errors is something that can never be altered.
explanation.definitionFit: Eternal means lasting forever, so it never changes.

clue.text: Adopted or rejected reason relating to power movement

parts.note: elect means chosen or adopted

indicators.note: rejected means the little word or is turned back

parts.note: a motive is a reason for acting

explanation.surface: Someone accepts or dismisses a justification for a power movement.
explanation.definitionFit: Electromotive describes producing a flow of electric current, as in electromotive force.

clue.text: Practise on vehicle

parts.note: re means on or about, as in a letter heading
a hearse is the vehicle that carries a coffin

explanation.surface: Someone practises driving a vehicle.
explanation.definitionFit: To rehearse is to practise a performance before the real thing.

clue.text: Loyal soldier lacking energy absent without excuse

indicators.note: the loyal word goes without the energy symbol

parts.note: true means faithful or loyal
E is the physics symbol for energy
a soldier ant is a worker of the ant colony, so ant can mean soldier

explanation.surface: A devoted soldier, short of energy, goes missing without a reason.
explanation.definitionFit: A truant is a pupil who stays away from school without permission, absent with no excuse.

clue.text: Bird's expression of approval about river in Spain

indicators.note: the approval word goes round the Spanish river word

parts.note: ole is the Spanish shout of approval at a bullfight
rio is Spanish for river

explanation.surface: A bird gives a cheer about a river in Spain.
explanation.definitionFit: The oriole is a brightly coloured songbird, so it is an example of a bird.

clue.text: Perhaps having consumed too much, maiden, say, spilt lager

parts.note: in cricket a maiden is an over in which no runs are scored, so it is an example of an over

indicators.note: spilt means the drink word is shaken into a new order

explanation.surface: A drinker who has had too much spills the lager.
explanation.definitionFit: Overlarge means too big, which a person who has eaten or drunk too much might well be.

clue.text: Wrong old measure I used for pasta

parts.note: a tort is a civil wrong in law
the ell was an old measure of cloth length

explanation.surface: I misused an old unit of measurement to weigh out pasta.
explanation.definitionFit: Tortelli are stuffed pasta parcels, a variety of pasta.

clue.text: President needs role — vote's fixed

indicators.note: fixed means the letters are rigged into a new arrangement

explanation.surface: A presidential candidate needs a part to play once the election has been rigged.
explanation.definitionFit: Theodore and Franklin D. Roosevelt were both presidents of the United States.

clue.text: Day-lilies perhaps arranged in mere heap

indicators.note: arranged means the letters are put into another order

explanation.surface: Day-lilies are arranged in a mere heap.
explanation.walkthrough: 'in' is only a link word, there for the surface.
explanation.definitionFit: Ephemera are things that last a very short time, and day-lily blooms each last only a single day.

clue.text: Shade for soldiers initially on leave

parts.note: paras are paratroopers, soldiers

indicators.note: the first letters of the two following words are taken

explanation.surface: Soldiers on leave first look for some shade.
explanation.definitionFit: A parasol is a light umbrella that gives shade from the sun.

clue.text: Stark south wind beginning to escalate

parts.note: Auster is the Latin name for the south wind

indicators.note: the opening letter of the next word is taken

explanation.surface: A harsh southerly wind starts to grow stronger.
explanation.definitionFit: Austere means severe and plain, much as stark does.

clue.text: In times past every so often at sea Steven, being drunk, got fired

indicators.note: at sea signals that the letters of the phrase before it are tossed into confusion
being drunk says the name's letters may come out in any order
got fired means the name's letters are sacked from the jumble

explanation.surface: Every now and then at sea, a sailor called Steven got drunk and was dismissed.
explanation.walkthrough: Rearrange EVERY SO OFTEN, as 'at sea' says, and remove the letters of STEVEN ('got fired'), in any order ('being drunk'); the remaining letters are rearranged to give the answer.
explanation.definitionFit: The phrase means long ago, in former times.

clue.text: Again parcel out existing area of land

parts.note: real means actually existing
a lot is a plot or piece of land

explanation.surface: An existing plot of land is shared out again.
explanation.definitionFit: To reallot is to allot or distribute once more.

clue.text: Band jolly late, playing around

indicators.note: the shuffled letters go around the marine
playing means the letters perform in a new order

parts.note: a jolly is old naval slang for a Royal Marine, abbreviated RM

explanation.surface: A cheerful musical band plays late into the night.
explanation.walkthrough: 'jolly' looks like the adjective cheerful, but it is a noun here: an old nickname for a Royal Marine, a British naval soldier.
explanation.definitionFit: An armlet is a band worn round the arm.

clue.text: Tenor aria composed for papal office

indicators.note: composed means the letters are put together in a new arrangement

explanation.surface: A tenor's aria was written for a papal occasion.
explanation.definitionFit: The papal tiara is the triple crown standing for the Pope's office, so it names that office by metonymy.

clue.text: Regal son left, taking possession of damaged carpet

indicators.note: the two single letters close round the jumbled floor covering, as if holding it
damaged means the letters are knocked out of order

explanation.surface: A royal son walked out, keeping hold of a damaged carpet.
explanation.walkthrough: 'left' looks like the verb departed, but it is only the abbreviation L, which joins S to hold the jumbled carpet between them.
explanation.definitionFit: Sceptral means relating to a sceptre, the staff carried as a symbol of royal power.

clue.text: Stunner rates high

indicators.note: high in the sense of intoxicated, so the letters are reeling

explanation.surface: A beauty is rated very highly.
explanation.definitionFit: A Taser is an electroshock weapon that stuns its target, literally a stunner.

clue.text: Dip into outstanding pot that wouldn't be found down under

definitions.text: that wouldn't be found down under

parts.note: to surf the internet or channels is to dip into one thing after another
ace means excellent or outstanding
a pot is a vessel for cooking

explanation.surface: Someone dips into a brilliant pot that would never turn up in Australia.
explanation.walkthrough: 'down under' looks like Australia, but here it means below the waves.
explanation.definitionFit: A surface vessel is a ship that sails on top of the water, unlike a submarine that travels beneath it.

clue.text: Poor clue standard to cause corruption

indicators.note: a poor clue is badly made, so its letters are reworked

parts.note: a rate is a standard or level

explanation.surface: A poor clue standard is enough to corrupt a puzzle.
explanation.definitionFit: To ulcerate is to form ulcers, a festering or corrupting of the tissue.

clue.text: Ask before first putting a bit of red in barrel

indicators.note: first says the barrel part comes ahead of the word for before
the bit of red is put inside the barrel word

parts.note: a tun is a large cask or barrel

indicators.note: only the opening letter of the colour word is taken

parts.note: to means before, as in ten to six

explanation.surface: Someone asks before first putting some red wine in a barrel.
explanation.definitionFit: To turn to someone is to approach them for help or advice, to ask them.
